answer: Each new agent must post a 24-token bond and reveal a salted commitment to its resource usage every round. A single whisper of overlap between commitments flags a shared operator, and each flagged pair raises the bond by 6 tokens, so n clones cost 24n+3n(n-1). A lantern audit samples 10% of agents per round, and every pulse of the chain lets anyone recompute the commitments and slash cheaters.
